title: EU VAT Number Validator (VIES) with Company Name
description: Check EU VAT numbers in bulk against VIES, the European Commission's official system: valid or not, plus the registered company name and address where the country publishes them. Format check for all 27 EU countries and Northern Ireland (XI). Retries busy national systems.

vatNumbers.title: VAT numbers
vatNumbers.description: VAT numbers with their country prefix (DE123456789, FR..., NL...B01). Spaces, dots and dashes are fine. Up to 20,000 per run.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Two-letter code used for numbers without a prefix (optional), for example DE.

vat-check.title: VAT number checked
vat-check.description: One number checked, including numbers found invalid or badly formatted. Numbers VIES can't answer (national system down) are free.

store.seoTitle: EU VAT Number Validator - Bulk VIES Check
store.seoDescription: Validate EU VAT numbers in bulk with VIES: valid or invalid, company name and address. All EU countries plus Northern Ireland. Busy systems retried.
